settings.info: Tour Caddie v4 loads Archivo + IBM Plex Mono in theme.liquid to match the app. This picker is retained for theme editor compatibility only.

settings.content: Archivo carries display and interface type — the wordmark's own typeface. IBM Plex Mono marks measured evidence (chips, dosages, specimen labels). The same pairing ships on app.caddieinsight.com.
